content.general_info: The document is a clinical guideline focusing on the diagnosis and management of atrial fibrillation. It discusses various treatment options, including drug therapies and interventional procedures like catheter ablation. The guideline also reviews studies investigating the effectiveness of different interventions and strategies to manage atrial fibrillation and its associated complications.

genes.context: Association of SGLT2 inhibitors with risk of atrial fibrillation and stroke in patients with and without type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
